### Housing Policy Targets Affordability in Year Marked by Legislative Change


Arbor Realty Trust’s Affordable Housing Trends Report, developed in partnership with Chandan Economics, explores a year marked by one of the most significant policy shifts in decades, with consequential developments in both the marketplace and the political arena. Our annual report finds that although affordability continues to present challenges, this year’s new initiatives are set to rebuild tomorrow’s pipeline.


**Key Findings:**


- The U.S. rent burden remained elevated following a recent wave of multifamily completion, with renters earning less than $30,000 annually spending an average of 57.6% of their income on rent.


- Fully and partially affordable units are projected to rise from 29.4% of apartment completions in 2025 to 37.7% by 2028.


- Expanded GSE requirements, higher LIHTC investment limits, and the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act have widened the pool of capital available to affordable housing.
